'''Star Tours Flight 1212''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] and [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had arrived on time at 0640 hours at the spaceport's Gate 1B and was boarding passengers in preparation for its departure at 0735.
